symmetric_peg_shape — DRIVE pegtactile op

• Data kinds: text → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.symmetric_peg_shape(name: 'str', size: 'int' = 160, radius: 'float' = 50.0, angle: 'float' = 0.0, centre=None, ss: 'int' = 8) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import pegtactile; pegtactile.symmetric_peg_shape(name: 'str', size: 'int' = 160, radius: 'float' = 50.0, angle: 'float' = 0.0, centre=None, ss: 'int' = 8) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("symmetric_peg_shape"))

Usage

Peg cross-section (synthetic with ground truth, anti-aliased coverage 0..1, (size, size)): circle, equilateral triangle, square, regular hexagon (circumradius radius [px]), and keyed circle (D-cut: part of the circle cut off by a chord, n = 1). The shape is drawn rotated by angle [rad] (rotating the image would introduce interpolation). centre = (col, row), ss = subsamples per pixel along 1 side. Raises ValueError: unknown shape, size < 16, radius ≤ 0, ss < 1.
